working_tree: Includes prior uncommitted build28/29/30 changes; no stage, commit or push.
implementation: Dart import/export/part URI hit testing preserves complete SDK, package and relative paths, including punctuation and UTF-16 names.
Library signature and Declared metadata come from existing SDK hover parsing; no invented package resolution or fabricated definitions.
Complete URI shares hover dwell, revision/context cache, confirmed navigation underline/hand and definition cache used by Command-click, middle-click and Command-B.
Bounded source window: up to 16 prior lines and 8192 UTF-16 units per primary pass; truncated-context fallback shares a second 8192-unit budget, no full-source copy, disk lookup or scan.
Conditional and multiline directives, prefix/nested/long comments and ordinary strings have regression fixtures; this is not a complete Dart AST lexer.
Editor context menu measures titles/shortcuts, minimum 220pt and maximum 360pt with screen clamp; visible themed separators retain existing non-key panel/event lifecycle.
Editing history, clipboard/selection, navigation, supported refactor/import and formatting groups; parameter information placed with navigation.
